name: Helena Clementine
source:
While typically a stern personality, a little more than meets the eye for Helena Clementine. She is the homeroom teacher for a 12th Year English class at the Hyde Colligate Institute and a rather young one at that.

Due to her outwardly younger appearance, it's harder for her to be taken seriously as a teacher. So she compensates by putting on an attitude she feels is more befitting of a teacher.

In truth, she is still a young woman and she evem secretly has a "party girl" personality that she would never dare let her students know about. It would ruin her already crumbling stern facade and get taken even less seriously.

However, part of that secrecy gives her even more thrill eating out and clubbing on the weekends. It helps her take the edge off from all her stresses in life job, so long as things remained as is.
